title: 〜おうとすると
meaning: A voluntary action stopped just before being completed
meaning_example: I was about to go out when the phone rang.

sections.body_text:

comments.text: The voluntary action is just stopped a moment before being completed by an unexpected external cause. The verb of the main sentence is often in the passive form.
